---
title: "Review checklist: partner-dependence checks"
output: html_document
---

The worked examples are consolidated in
[Checking partner dependence](partner-dependence-vignette-draft.Rmd).
Use this checklist when reviewing changes:

- Do observed and simulated responses use the same fitted rows, centring, and
  statistic, with all random-effect blocks redrawn?
- Are complete pairs and role order correct, including omitted identifiers?
- Are undefined simulated statistics counted and their conditional references
  clearly labelled?
- Do the examples distinguish restrictive models from models that freely
  estimate the checked feature, without treating positions as p-values?

The [reference validation](partner-dependence-reference-validation.Rmd) checks
independent covariance calculations. The
[outer simulation study](partner-dependence-outer-simulation-study.Rmd) examines
repeated-sample behavior. See the [guide](README.md) for validation commands.
